learning: For supervised handoff preflight, classify inspect-only as audited read-only inspection: validate target/environment/binding permit parity, but do not require handoff-accept authority, prior permits, or handoff-accept budget.
evidence: CAS review on PR #4 head 7dc8dc4 found inspect-only preflightWithPermit rejected or charged accept-only permit state before any accept mode was selected.
application: When adding permit gates around handoff APIs, branch first on whether the operation actually accepts handoff state; keep inspect-only under audit-mode certificate checks.

learning: For audit-only supervision budgets, keep terminal blocker state separate from warning evidence because completed runs should not publish a RunReceipt.blocker for allowed budget warnings.
evidence: CAS review on PR #4 head 4db9bd7 found Supervisor.exceed set self.blocker before audit_only_on_budget_exceeded converted the check to allowed.
application: When budgetBehavior is audit_only, preserve ledger.exceeded_budget and last_check warning details, but assign Supervisor.blocker only in fail or park branches.

learning: When adding permit-aware public preflight helpers, prefer validating the full permit authority tuple before returning accepted to prevent the helper from becoming a looser shadow authorization path than Machine.start.
evidence: CAS current-head review on PR #4 found acceptanceReportWithPermit accepted a broad fresh permit for replay preflight before mode/environment/binding checks.
application: Check mode, target, world surface, target certificate, environment certificate, binding plan, and permit self-validation, then add a direct false-positive regression test.

learning: When startup writes multiple transcript events under supervision, prefer atomic append or rollback to prevent a denied later event from leaving an unterminated run in caller-owned transcripts.
evidence: CAS current-head review on PR #4 found max_transcript_events=1 could append run_started, fail permit_issued, and leave replay validation with a malformed active run.
application: Wrap startup transcript append groups with a pre-count rollback, and test tight event/image budgets leave no partial startup transcript.
